item.title: UK to host Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky for state visit in 2027
item.body: The visit would aim to project solidarity with Ukraine in what will be the fifth year of its war against Russia.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🇺🇦 UK to host Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky for state visit in 2027

The visit would aim to project solidarity with Ukraine in what will be the fifth year of its war against Russia.
